title: Jambette is home! 🐸
summary: I met Jambette on a Nook Miles island, invited her to Hopscotch, and she has officially moved in!
paragraphs: She looked absolutely adorable on the beach in her little pink dress, with the most gorgeous sunset behind her.
That makes three froggy neighbours living on Hopscotch now: Diva, Ribbot and Jambette. The Frog Pond is growing!

title: A VIP room for Puddles 🌸
summary: Puddles made an appearance at the hotel, so of course I gave her a very special VIP room.
paragraphs: I went with a Japanese nature theme: cosy timber furniture, bonsai, hydrangeas and that lovely peaceful evening atmosphere.
She is a hotel guest rather than a resident of Hopscotch, but she absolutely deserves her own little spot in my frog collection.

images.alt: Puddles standing inside her Japanese nature-themed VIP hotel room, with bonsai and hydrangea wall decor
images.caption: Puddles in her Japanese nature retreat 🌿

title: Back to Hopscotch
summary: Almost a year after registering Hopscotch, I'm finally coming back to give the island the attention it deserves.
paragraphs: Hopscotch was registered on August 26th, 2025, but I never really finished building it. Most of the island is still pretty barren, so instead of restarting I'm treating this as a full rebuild.

The old island stays, the villagers stay, and all the progress I've already made counts — but from here I'm going to properly document everything as Hopscotch turns into the pink, froggy island I actually wanted.
This is my passport at the start of the rebuild: Violet, resident representative of Hopscotch, with peaches as the native fruit and a very appropriate passport title of Ultimate Egg.

images.alt: Violet's Animal Crossing New Horizons passport for Hopscotch at the beginning of the island rebuild
